Alan Law won the Weight, and H. Powell, the son of our old champion, George Powell, followed in his father's footsteps by winning the Javelin Throw.
Ansell won the Junior Long Jump and was also fourth in the Senior event, with young H. Powell winning the Javelin Throw, and he is showing steady improvement.
The best junior performance was that of J.Powell-Jones who won the shot put with a new County record of 48ft.10ins. H. Powell wo was third in the javelin and B.

I have had some interesting letters from members in the Forces including S.R.Day who is lacking training facilities, Brian Windley who is in Berlin and competed in the Brigade Championships (results not yet to hand), H. Powell at Padgate and D.
